```{r}
source("setup.R")
```

Read in park system
```{r}
park_system <- getParkSystem()
```

Filter for testing
```{r}
park_sub <- park_system %>% filter(STATE == "UT")
```

Read in water supply database for filtered parks
```{r}
table_path <- "data/Water_Supply_Systems/NPS_Water_Systems_Database_Joined.xlsx"

water_supplies <- read_excel(table_path, sheet = 1, na = "NA", skip = 1) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
      dplyr::filter(park_unit %in% park_sub$UNIT_CODE) %>%
     drop_na(source_longitude, source_longitude) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = (c("source_longitude","source_latitude")),
           crs = 4326,
            remove = FALSE)
```


Climate data for each point? Or aoi....
